name: paios
description: Connect Codex to a scoped PAIOS instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped PAIOS tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to PAIOS through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so PAIOS Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PAIOS only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
